text:
Alex: evening async — quick status
Alex: what I did: pushed hotfix to routing fallback (PR 456), added extra logs for fallback path. Blockers: still seeing ~2% 99th latency spikes when cache miss + cold start. Today: roll out canary of smaller batch size and monitor traces.
Maya: saw the spikes in the traces, looks like KV eviction at ~02:14 is correlated. I'll own alert tuning and runbook updates.
Maya: linking runbook draft: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/kv-evict (WIP)
Chris: on CR ping — will review PR 456 tonight, can you rebase? also add a short unit test for the fallback metric.
Alex: rebased and pushed test, thanks. cc @Chris
Sam: quick note — noticed noisy 5xx alerts from shard-a. I traced to a transient OOM on replica-2, restarted and it's stable now. Opening follow-up ticket: INC-789.
oncall-bot: Alert: KV_CACHE_EVICT_RATE_HIGH on customer-prod - 3 occurrences in 15m. Pager escalations suppressed (investigating).
Maya: I'll mute noisy alert for 10m while I tune thresholds, then post changes here.
Chris: reviewed PR 456, left one small comment about metric labels. LGTM besides that.
Alex: will update metric labels and merge after CI.
Sam: assigning INC-789 to @Sam, ETA tomorrow morning to dig into replica memory leak.
Maya: plan for today: 1) tune alert thresholds, 2) update runbook steps for eviction + rollback, 3) watch canary for batch-size change. Will post results in ~2h.
Alex: thanks all — if oncall sees more alerts ping here, otherwise I'll roll the canary at 22:30 PST. :thumbsup:
